query: How does the battery of the Google Pixel 3a XL hold up during a full day, and do owners report unexpected drain?
search_text: How does the battery of the hold up during a full day, and do owners report unexpected drain?

rows.text: One of the reasons why I like the pixel 3axl so much is the battery. It charges quick and depending on how much I use it I can go a full day without charging it again. So far the phone that I received charges very very slow no matter what charger I use, and the battery seems to be less than desirable. I charged it up to 100% yesterday before I went to bed and by the time I woke up it was on 4%. Then I plugged it in up to 100% and less than an hour later it's already below 80% without me even touching it. I will update more in a couple of days... I might need to return it just on the battery alone
Like brand new. No screen scratches. Battery holds a decent charge. It came with Android 12 already on it. Quick shipping.

I received a phone that looked nice, I really liked it at first.. I really liked how the phone looked when I first got it I was very happy, but then I started using it and since I already owned this exact model new how long the battery should last. I emailed the seller the first week I got this phone and said that I liked it at first but that the battery did not last as long as it should not once did they try and help me get a different phone or help with the battery I got one email asking about battery health but this phone does not have a battery health meter, so after several emails with no responses I gave up. Sadly I have to charge my phone several times a day, I can't wait to upgrade this device. Real and unhappy customer.

Great so far!. I've not had luck with refurbished products in the past, so I was nervous getting this, but it was really the only phone I could afford. All that being said so far this thing seems great. Fast. Long battery life. Looks absolutely brand new. Never would've known it was pre-used. I really enjoy this phone after 4 days of use. Amazon guarantees this for 90 days which provides some relief if anything happens. And the company I bought it from says they'll guarantee for a full year if I write this honest review. If anything changes with the phone or if I need to return for any reason I'll update this to let you know how the warranty offers and return processes are.

Like new! Make sure you look at seller ratings.. I was pretty nervous about ordering a renewed phone from Amazon because of all the mixed reviews. I learned that Amazon lists these phones from multiple refurbishers, and you are able to see the ratings of each one before you buy it. I went with "bayshine Trading" and bought 2 Pixel 3a XL's, both of which were like-new with no scratches on the screen and hardly any visible signs of use on the back. The battery also lasts the entire day with no issues. Don't just go with the cheapest seller, make sure you check out the seller ratings. Even if you aren't satisfied, you still have a 90 day return window.
Battery issues. Battery will not fully charge. I don’t recommend buying.

phone started smoking out of the charging port.. What did I like? How cheap the phone was. What I didn't like? When it started smoking out of the charging port exactly one month and eleven days after purchase. Maybe, just maybe, if someone's selling refurbs that begin smoking out of the charging port after one month and eleven days, they shouldn't be selling refurbs at all. It's a good thing I was awake whilst it was charging - don't want to think about what may have happened if I charged the phone while asleep (what a lot of people do) tl;dr bought a new phone, received a repurposed bomb.

One of the best phones of 2019. This phone is one of the best phones in 2019. I consistently get 2 days of battery life with moderate to heavy use. The latest Google features are also amazing. Also, you are getting one of the best cameras at a budget price. I bought a refurbished model and it looked and worked perfectly since day one.

Looks & Works Like New in Perfect Condition. My wife and I both bought our Google Pixel 3a XL phones new about 18 months ago. We wanted to get one for our daughter but looked on ebay and other places. We paid about 20$ more for this used phone but it came in perfect condition. Obviously, the previous owner had used a screen protector and case. The battery seems to be just as good as our own and still lasts through the day. I was concerned about buying a used phone but glad I bought from this seller. Thank you for offering us a great used phone

Reasonably priced, great battery life, quality camera. I had purchased the 3a xl, but first time was sent the wrong item. Returned the phone and received the correct one without a hassle, just took longer than expected. The phone comes packaged nicely and with a screen protector already installed. Cannot tell the phone has ever been used. The battery life is amazing. The phone itself has so many features which can become overwhelming. With that being said, it's surprising how long the battery life is. I can last about 2 days while still using several features all day long. The camera is probably the greatest feature of the phone. The phone was reasonably priced. Would reccommend purchasing.

Good condition refurb. Purchased this phone as a quick replacement as the 4a hadn't yet released. Quality was good for a refurbished item, some small scuffs on back of phone but no structural or screen damage. Phone's doing well so far, the battery life has gone down a bit I'm assuming, cause I barely get a full days use out of it. But for the price and the quick shipping I'm happy overall.

Really solid phone, glad I got it.. First and foremost, I'd like to mention that mine came from SoonerSoft Electronics, and wow, do they know how to refurbish a phone! When it arrived, the phone looked brand new! I mostly got it to run Calyx OS, so I can't say much about the default experience out of the box because I changed the OS immediately, which took about 5-10 minutes. The device has been fantastic for day-to-day use! The battery is smaller than other phones I've used, but it lasts at least two days and recharges quickly, which is useful if I ever use the phone a lot.
Worth. Excellent quality. Battery came at 100% and zero wear. Great condition. Amazon's Renewed service is supreme.

4 days out of 90 day warranty and no help.. I got the phone on apr. 2nd and literally only 4 days out of the 90 days warranty the charging port has failed. I would expect better from tech companies as i work for a tech company also. I contacted amazon services to see if they could help and since its out was a big NO. So i will have to get fixed myself because the product failed 4 days out of warranty i am livid. WOULD NOT BUY AGAIN!
Not meant for heavy use. Well it’s a Pixel after all so it works well. However the battery life of this renewed phone isn’t that great. you need to keep charging if you are using it heavily

Battery life terrible. The phone works okay but I've had this phone before and this phone versus my old phone the battery is subpar is awful by the time I take it off the charger it's already dropped to 99%. And by lunch it's almost dead That's what low to moderate use One out of five stars would not recommend

Great phone, EXCELLENT seller!!. Got this to replace my pixel 2 after which was struggling to last 7 hours in my pocket. Phone is great- a smidge slower on some things with the mid-range chip, but noticably better screen, camera, and most of all BATTERY. The 3a xl is giving me 18 hours of life with 5 hours+ of screen-on time. But hats off to the seller! ReCell got it to me 1 day early and this thing is in PRISTINE condition. Many thanks for that!

Not bad for a used device. Accepting the discount for the previously used device, functionally the phone is quite nice. It was not without issues; namely some burn in on the display, which indicated the prior user played a lot of cookie-jam. Also soon after my usage I identified a dead pixel, which is annoying, but for my day-to-day existence doesn't really bother me. Otherwise it is a handsomely appointed device with a great battery life, strong wifi calling, Great Camera, and is every bit the pocket tablet. And more affordable than a brand new device.

Love this phone. This is the second phone I've bought from the seller. It looks like brand new and it works like brand new. This is an amazing phone if you count on battery life. I wish it had wireless charging but oh well.

Very Impressed. As described, looks and works like new. I usually can only afford low end phones so I thought I would take a chance on a used mid-range phone. Battery lasts well over a day and the display is bright and clear with no burn-in. Can't wait to try the camera.
